skills.name: vite-react-best-practices
skills.description: Comprehensive React 19 and Vite 8 SPA performance, architecture, and deployment guidelines. Use this skill when building, reviewing, or refactoring React applications built with Vite (SPA). Covers Vite 8 build and static hosting requirements, React Router 8 route-level code splitting, TanStack Query v5 server state, React Compiler memoization, and core React performance patterns.
